source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 10: Modal Verbs — may/might

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ

starter.stem: The meeting ___ be postponed due to the storm.
starter.explanation_short: Khả năng có thể xảy ra → may.
starter.feedback_wrong: Khả năng xảy ra → may + V.

starter.stem: Climate change ___ cause even more severe weather events in the future.
starter.explanation_short: Khả năng thấp hơn may → might.
starter.explanation_long: Might = lower probability than may. Cả hai đều diễn tả possibility.
starter.ielts_tip: might + V = lower possibility than may.

starter.stem: ___ I leave early today? I have a doctor's appointment.
starter.explanation_long: May I = formal permission. Can I = informal permission.
starter.feedback_wrong: May I = formal. Can I = informal.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: Might (ít dùng xin phép), Do (sai)

starter.stem: Deforestation ___ not stop unless governments take action.
starter.explanation_short: may not = có thể không. Không viết tắt: mayn't.
starter.explanation_long: Phủ định: may not (không viết tắt thành mayn't trong formal English).
starter.feedback_correct: 🎯 may not + V = có thể không
starter.feedback_wrong: may not + V. Không viết tắt.
starter.ielts_tip: may not / might not + V = possibly not.

starter.stem: You ___ want to consider renewable energy for your factory.
starter.explanation_short: Gợi ý nhẹ nhàng → might want to.
starter.explanation_long: might want to = gợi ý lịch sự, nhẹ nhàng.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Gợi ý nhẹ nhàng → might want to
starter.ielts_tip: might want to + V = gentle suggestion.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: mights (sai), can (khả năng, không gợi ý)

starter.stem: Pollution ___ affect public health in urban areas.
starter.explanation_short: Khả năng xảy ra → may affect.
starter.explanation_long: may + V = possibility. Mô tả khả năng ô nhiễm ảnh hưởng sức khỏe.

starter.stem: The government ___ introduce new environmental regulations next year.
This research ___ contribute to solving global warming.
starter.explanation_short: Academic writing: may contribute → khả năng học thuật.
starter.explanation_long: may + V = academic possibility. Dùng nhiều trong research papers.

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Rising sea levels may to affect millions of people.'
options: Sai: may to affect → may affect (bỏ to)
starter.correct_answer: Sai: may to affect → may affect (bỏ to)
starter.explanation_short: may + V bare: may affect (không may to affect).
starter.explanation_long: Modal + V bare infinitive. 'May to affect' = sai.

starter.stem: There ___ be a connection between social media use and mental health issues.
starter.explanation_short: Khả năng có liên kết → may be.
starter.explanation_long: may/might đều đúng. Trong academic, may phổ biến hơn.
starter.ielts_tip: Academic: There may be a connection/link/correlation...

build_up.stem: Experts suggest that social media ___ have negative effects on mental health, but more research is needed.
build_up.explanation_short: Academic suggestion + chưa chắc → may have.
build_up.explanation_long: 'More research is needed' = chưa chắc chắn → may (khả năng cao hơn might nhưng chưa xác nhận).
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Academic + chưa xác nhận → may have
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: might (cũng đúng nhưng may phổ biến hơn trong academic)

build_up.stem: The ancient civilization ___ have used advanced technology that we don't know about.
build_up.explanation_short: Suy đoán về quá khứ xa → might have V3.
build_up.explanation_long: Might have V3 = suy đoán về quá khứ, ít chắc chắn.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ Suy đoán quá khứ xa → might have used
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: may (cũng đúng nhưng might tự nhiên hơn cho quá khứ xa)

build_up.stem: This finding ___ suggest that environmental factors play a larger role than previously thought.
build_up.explanation_long: 'May suggest' = academic hedging (cautious language) phổ biến trong research.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Deforestation may leads to the extinction of many species.'
options: Sai: may leads → may lead (modal + V bare)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: may leads → may lead (modal + V bare)
build_up.explanation_short: may + V bare: may lead (không may leads).
build_up.explanation_long: Modal + V bare infinitive. Không thêm -s sau modal.

build_up.stem: If we don't reduce emissions, global temperatures ___ rise by 3 degrees.
build_up.explanation_short: Điều kiện + hậu quả không chắc → might.
build_up.explanation_long: 'If we don't reduce' = conditional → might rise (possibility, less certain than will).
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: may (cũng đúng), will (quá chắc chắn)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Some people mayn't be aware of the environmental impact of their choices.'
options: Sai: mayn't → may not (may không viết tắt thành mayn't)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: mayn't → may not (may không viết tắt thành mayn't)
build_up.explanation_short: may not (không viết tắt): may not be aware.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Mayn't' gần như không dùng trong English hiện đại. Đúng: may not.
build_up.feedback_wrong: may not (full form). Might not = mightn't (informal).
build_up.ielts_tip: may not = full form. mightn't = informal OK.

build_up.stem: Students ___ not use their phones during the exam.
build_up.explanation_short: Quy định/rule → may not = không được phép.
build_up.explanation_long: may not = prohibition (formal rule). can't = informal prohibition.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ Quy định formal → may not use
build_up.ielts_tip: Exam rules: may not = formal prohibition.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Climate change might to cause widespread food shortages in the next decade.'
options: Sai: might to cause → might cause (bỏ to)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: might to cause → might cause (bỏ to)
build_up.explanation_short: might + V bare: might cause (không might to cause).

build_up.stem: Renewable energy sources ___ eventually replace fossil fuels entirely.
build_up.explanation_short: Khả năng tương lai → may replace.
build_up.explanation_long: may = possibility. 'Eventually' = tương lai không xác định → may.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ Khả năng tương lai → may replace

build_up.stem: The new environmental policy ___ not be enough to address climate change.
build_up.explanation_short: Suy đoán → might not be enough.
build_up.explanation_long: might not = suy đoán rằng có thể không đủ.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Suy đoán → might not be enough
build_up.ielts_tip: might not + V = có thể không.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Overpopulation may to lead to resource depletion, which might causes widespread poverty.'
challenge.explanation_short: may + V bare: may lead (không may to lead).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'may to lead' → 'may lead'. Lớp 2: 'might causes' cũng sai → 'might cause'. Cả A và C sai, A sai trước.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (might causes) cũng sai

challenge.stem: Chọn câu CHUẨN NHẤT cho IELTS Writing Task 2:
options: Air pollution may leads to serious health problems in urban areas.
Air pollution may lead to serious health problems in urban areas.
Air pollution might to lead to serious health problems.
Air pollution mays lead to serious health problems.
challenge.correct_answer: Air pollution may lead to serious health problems in urban areas.
challenge.explanation_short: may + V bare: may lead to.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'may lead' = đúng (modal + V bare). Lớp 2: 'may leads' sai (-s). Lớp 3: 'might to lead' sai (to). Lớp 4: 'mays' không tồn tại.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 may + V bare: may lead to = chuẩn!
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2: may lead to/result in/cause = hedging.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (may leads) lỗi phổ biến

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'While some argue that social media mays harm society, others believe it might helps connect communities.'
challenge.explanation_short: mays không tồn tại. Đúng: may harm.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'mays' không tồn tại → 'may harm'. Lớp 2: 'might helps' cũng sai → 'might help'. Cả B và D sai, B sai rõ nhất.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 mays không tồn tại → may harm!
challenge.ielts_tip: Modal verbs không chia theo ngôi.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (might helps) cũng sai

challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT cho quy định formal:
options: Students can't use phones during exams.
Students may not use electronic devices during examinations.
Students might not use phones during exams.
challenge.correct_answer: Students may not use electronic devices during examinations.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'may not' = formal prohibition. Lớp 2: 'can't' = informal. Lớp 3: 'might not' = possibility, không phải prohibition. Lớp 4: 'don't may' = sai.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (can't) đúng nhưng informal

challenge.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN cho IELTS Writing?
'This trend ___ [A] that social values ___ [B] shifting towards greater environmental awareness.'
challenge.explanation_short: may + V bare: may suggest. values = plural → are.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: may + suggest (V bare, no -s). Lớp 2: 'social values' = plural → 'are shifting'.
challenge.feedback_wrong: may + V bare. Plural subject → are.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Had the government invested in renewable energy earlier, air quality might has improved significantly by now.'
challenge.explanation_short: might + have V3 (không might has): might have improved.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: might + have + V3 = past possibility. 'Might has' = sai, phải là 'might have'. Modal không chia.
challenge.feedback_wrong: might + have + V3. Modal không chia.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (Had + invested) = đúng (Conditional Type 3 inverted)

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Industrial pollution may contributes to global warming and its effects might be irreversible.
Industrial pollution may contribute to global warming
and its effects might be irreversible.
Industrial pollution might to contribute to global warming.
Industrial pollution mays contribute to global warming.
challenge.correct_answer: Industrial pollution may contribute to global warming, and its effects might be irreversible.
challenge.explanation_short: may contribute + might be = đúng modal + V bare.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'may contribute' = hedging (modal + V bare). Lớp 2: 'might be irreversible' = lower certainty. Lớp 3: 'may contributes' sai (-s). Lớp 4: 'might to contribute' sai (to).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 may contribute + might be = academic hedging chuẩn!
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2: may contribute/lead to + might be = nuanced hedging.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Some developing countries mayn't have the resources to combat climate change, which may leads to greater inequality.'
options: which may leads to greater inequality
challenge.explanation_short: mayn't → may not (không viết tắt mayn't).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'mayn't' → 'may not' (may không viết tắt phủ định). Lớp 2: 'may leads' cũng sai → 'may lead'. Cả B và D sai, B rõ nhất.
challenge.feedback_wrong: may not (full form). Modal + V bare.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (may leads) cũng sai

challenge.stem: Speaking Part 3: 'Bạn nghĩ xã hội có thể thay đổi thái độ về môi trường không?' — Chọn CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: I think people may changes their attitudes towards the environment.
Society might gradually shift towards more sustainable practices.
People mays change their environmental attitudes.
Society may to become more environmentally conscious.
challenge.correct_answer: Society might gradually shift towards more sustainable practices.
challenge.explanation_short: might + V bare = cautious prediction chuẩn Speaking.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'might gradually shift' = cautious + natural. Lớp 2: 'may changes' sai (-s). Lớp 3: 'mays' sai. Lớp 4: 'may to become' sai (to).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 might gradually shift = chuẩn Speaking Part 3!
challenge.feedback_wrong: might + adverb + V = cautious natural speech.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: các option khác đều sai modal form

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'Urbanization [A] may leads to overcrowding, which [B] mights cause social problems, and governments [C] might not has the resources to address all issues.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] may leads → may lead. [B] mights → might. [C] might not has → might not have.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] 'may leads' → 'may lead' (modal + V bare). Lớp 2: [B] 'mights' không tồn tại → 'might'. Lớp 3: [C] 'might not has' → 'might not have' (modal không chia).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] may lead | [B] might cause | [C] might not have!
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] modal + V bare. [B] modal không chia. [C] modal + have (not has).
challenge.ielts_tip: Modal + V bare. Modal không chia theo ngôi.
